# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-33

This Xteink X4 Pro release makes library synchronization indexing substantially
faster by moving EPUB metadata extraction to the sync server.

## Improved

- Synchronized books now use title, author, series, publication year, tags, and
  text-size metadata supplied by the CrossPoint sync manifest.
- New and updated synchronized books are added to the library index without a
  full EPUB text scan on the device.
- Multiple synchronized changes are committed to the library index in one
  batch while preserving existing reading progress.
- Books copied manually to the SD card continue to be indexed locally.

## Notes

- Reader-specific caches are still created when a book is opened for the first
  time.
- This release is published for Xteink X4 Pro only.
